method: Serialized JSON characters. Upstream: REA's own SDK listTools() catalog (.cache/mcp-tool-catalog.json, CI artifact rea-test-runtime, run 38565969170, release commit 3b79af28e). notes: model_visible = name + description + inputSchema; hosts using the Anthropic API do not send outputSchema to the model.
The electron_feature_trace saving is partly lossy: adapter introspection flattens structured params (MCPAQL/adapter-generator#55, #47, #19).

A public benchmark (aicodeking/leanrea bench/BENCHMARK.md) measured about 369k tokens of extra context with all REA tools loaded in Claude Code: 792,163 model-visible characters, about 2.15 characters per token for these schemas.
